description: The source establishes a co-simulation coupling SUMO mobility with Ethereum proof-of-stake blockchain for autonomous delivery robots. Experiments vary robot numbers and measure transaction execution and finality time to assess communication-system scaling. This is an implemented simulation architecture with a source-defined logistics role. Public code, exact network geography and production deployment are not established by the paper description. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
